questions: No package was installed or renderer executed. Local speed, native dependency compatibility, finished visual quality and synchronization of the approved 78.602449-second narration remain untested.

The one-node ant rig requires species-specific anatomy review. Crawler search found a Texas A&M Imported Fire Ant Model PDF describing two nodes, but that PDF was not read. The attempted older Texas Insects page redirected to a general homepage; do not treat that redirect or the search snippet as checked body evidence.

Some source snapshots are truncated. The older UF insect page and Texas Insects page redirect to general homepages and are excluded from substantive evidence; one guessed Texas A&M identification URL returned 404 before the correct page was retrieved.

Remotion commercial-license eligibility, full dependency-license compatibility and actual install resolution were not assessed. No paid service or new voice generation is required by the proposed first trial, but no all-purpose zero-cost guarantee is made.
Astra ultra appears in the existing local model cache; no new model generation or renderer benchmark was run. The recommendation remains a prototype choice, not a proven production pipeline.

actions.reason: Six candidates compared using primary descriptions and code. Ant toolkit is the first prototype recommendation because it has relevant drawing/nest modules and an inspected existing contact sheet; Anidoodle is the illustrated-art backup. No live quality ranking is claimed.

Record scientific corrections, new vertical layout and explicit scene timing against the existing audio. Reuse the original MP3; add naked pupae and avoid the demo central mound opening. Exact anatomy and timed output still need the future trial.

Declared packages and licensing were read. Local read-only inspection found Node/npm/FFmpeg already installed and neither candidate installed in this project. Recommend a small isolated ant toolkit trial and a separate Playwright-based backup; no installation or spending occurred.

Known documentation/setup limitations and all untested runtime questions are explicit. Recommend a short narration-matched test showing workers move brood through a textured nest before making the full video.

caveats: First choice and backup are caller recommendations based on fit; no new rendering, installation or full audiovisual review was performed.
Caller support checks establish contextual support in the retrieved text, not independent fact or model verification. Search snippets are leads only.
Public-source run: three searches and thirty page attempts. Twenty-nine snapshots were saved; two generic redirects are excluded from substantive evidence, and truncated snapshots are identified.

Existing approved narration remains unchanged. App files, whiteboard and diagrams were not edited. No external paid service, model call, video generation, installation or publishing occurred during this research.
